question: My GFCI outlet in the kitchen is not working and I need to replace it. Can you walk me through the steps?
answer: To replace a GFCI outlet, first turn off the power to the outlet at the main electrical panel. Then, remove the outlet cover plate and any screws holding the outlet in place. Carefully pull the outlet out of the electrical box. Disconnect the wires from the old outlet and connect them to the new outlet. Make sure the new outlet is properly seated in the electrical box and screw it in place. Finally, turn the power back on at the main electrical panel and test the outlet to make sure it's working properly.

safety_info: When working with electrical systems, always turn off the power to the circuit before starting work. Use a voltage tester to ensure the power is off. Wear protective gloves and safety glasses to prevent injury from electrical shock or flying debris.
tips: Use a non-contact voltage tester to ensure the power is off before starting work.
Take photos of the wiring before disconnecting it to help with reconnection later.
Consider hiring a licensed electrician if you're not comfortable working with electrical systems.
